turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: Our average order value grew by about 22.14 EUR, from 92.25 EUR in August 2026 to 114.39 EUR in September 2026 (the average over non-cancelled orders for each whole month). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
